STOKES-FROM-PERIODS BRIDGE (every factor explicit):
  (B0) 2b gauge dictionary [87be6028]: H2 --(trace-free)--> u''=r u, r=1/(3t^3)-5/(9t^2)-1/(3t);
       --(t=x^2)--> w''=R w, R=4/(3x^4)-53/(36x^2)-4/3; companion B=[[0,1],[R,0]] (D8 shape).
       The composite gauge is the SCALAR factor y = x^{-17/6} w.
  (B1) A scalar gauge y = g(x) w multiplies every formal solution by the SAME g, hence leaves
       the Stokes MATRICES (ratios of solutions across a Stokes ray) INVARIANT.  Therefore
       s*(B; x=0) = s*(H2; t=0) = the single off-diagonal Stokes multiplier of the slope-1/2
       ramified point (Stokes matrix [[1, s*],[0,1]] in the recessive/dominant basis).
  (B2) Stokes-from-periods (Borel realisation): for the slope-1/2 ramified point the Stokes
       multiplier is the connection coefficient between the recessive formal solution at the
       irregular point and the convergent z=0-analytic solution, read off on the Borel-2 plane
       Phi: s* = A_Phi = the (1-3z)^{-4/3} amplitude of Phi at the Borel singularity z=1/3.
       This is exactly the rapid-decay period pairing <[Phi], gamma_+> in the normalised basis
       (leading Frobenius coefficient c_0 = 1).
  (B3) Transfer normalisation (Flajolet-Sedgewick Thm VI.1): the leading-coeff-1 amplitude A_Phi
       and the large-order amplitude A0 = lim Q_n/((n!)^2 3^n n^{1/3}) satisfy A_Phi = Gamma(4/3) A0.
  (B4) cc3-2s2-1 bridge [8f52843c]: kappa := Gamma(4/3) A0.  Combining (B2)-(B4):
          kappa  =  Gamma(4/3) * A0  =  A_Phi  =  s*(B; x=0).
       The elementary normalisation factor between s* and kappa is the IDENTITY (both equal A_Phi);
       the factor between A_Phi and the large-order amplitude A0 is exactly Gamma(4/3).
  No improvised normalisation: identities id1/id2/id3 confirm every factor numerically to >=129 d.

grade_ladder.S4 Hadamard/Borel-2 contour pairing; div: STRUCTURAL (Borel-2 summable, slope-1/2; Loday-Richaud LNM 2154). The pairing is the Hadamard product contour; its convergence is the radius-1/3 of Phi.

grade_ladder.S6+ kappa is a period of the rank-2 expo: CONJECTURED-with-architecture (the abstract motivic pairing is cited, not constructed in the motivic category; the numeric realisation above is its constructive shadow).

S6_verdict: S6 CLOSED to STRUCTURAL: kappa lies in the ring of EXPONENTIAL PERIODS of the order-4 Borel operator L (z=infinity slope 1/4, finite sing {0,1/3}), realised CONSTRUCTIVELY as the connection coefficient A_Phi between the z=0-analytic solution and the exponent -4/3 Frobenius solution at z=1/3, computed to 129 digits with deformation-invariance and 4-component consistency witnesses (208/204 d).  The classical Kontsevich-Zagier period ring is NOT the home (L is globally irregular); the home is the Fresan-Jossen ring of exponential periods.  Full exponential-MOTIVE membership remains CONJECTURED.
ceiling: Exhibiting kappa as a constructive exponential period proves NOTHING about transcendence; a closed form would argue ELEMENTARITY-in-extended-class, a null neither. Unconditional transcendence of C/kappa is NOT a deliverable of op:cc-3.
